itens.titulo: CoinShares Says Bitcoin Won't Hit $80,000. Is It Correct?
itens.descricao: CoinShares Says Bitcoin Won't Hit $80,000. Is It Correct? Yahoo Finance
trechos: CoinShares does not expect Bitcoin price (BTC) to break above $80,000 this year.
Bitcoin trades near $78,040, about 2% below that level.
VanEck expects $100,000 within a year, which turns the forecast into a test of whose macro read holds.
Why CoinShares Sees Bitcoin Capped Below $80,000 The Federal Reserve raised rates a quarter point on Wednesday to a range of 3.75% to 4.00%.
It was the first increase since 2023.
Projections released with the decision also removed expected easing through 2027.
A decisive break above $80,000 is unlikely without better inflation data or a clear shift in policy expectations.
VanEck Sees $100,000 While On-Chain Data Weakens VanEck's Matthew Sigel told CNBC on Friday he expects Bitcoin to reach $100,000 by next year.
